description: Source code for the EmailDigest class and related functions in the ERPNext system, handling email digest generation, scheduling, and related data retrieval.

classes.name: EmailDigest
classes.description: Class representing an email digest configuration and content generator, including methods for scheduling, content creation, and data aggregation.

methods.name: get_users
methods.description: Retrieve list of users excluding website users, mark recipients based on stored recipient list.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Send email digest to scheduled recipients if the scheduled send date matches today.

methods.name: get_msg_html
methods.description: Build and render the email digest HTML content based on selected data and templates.

methods.name: set_title
methods.description: Set the title and subtitle of the digest based on its frequency (Daily, Weekly, Monthly).

methods.name: set_style
methods.description: Apply styling parameters to the email digest content.

methods.name: get_notifications
methods.description: Fetch user notifications for inclusion in the digest.

methods.name: get_calendar_events
methods.description: Retrieve calendar events for the user within the relevant date range.

methods.name: get_todo_list
methods.description: Retrieve open to-do items for the user.

methods.name: get_todo_count
methods.description: Count open to-do items for the user.

methods.name: get_issue_list
methods.description: Retrieve issues assigned to or relevant for the user.

methods.name: get_issue_count
methods.description: Count issues in open or replied status.

methods.name: get_project_list
methods.description: Retrieve list of external projects.

methods.name: get_project_count
methods.description: Count external projects.

methods.name: set_accounting_cards
methods.description: Generate accounting summary cards for the digest.

methods.name: get_income
methods.description: Calculate income for the reporting period.

methods.name: get_income_year_to_date
methods.description: Calculate income accumulated year-to-date.

methods.name: get_expense_year_to_date
methods.description: Calculate expenses accumulated year-to-date.

methods.name: get_year_to_date_balance
methods.description: Compute balance for a given root type and field for year-to-date.

methods.name: get_bank_balance
methods.description: Retrieve current bank balance.

methods.name: get_credit_balance
methods.description: Retrieve current credit balance.

methods.name: get_payables
methods.description: Retrieve total payables.

methods.name: get_invoiced_amount
methods.description: Retrieve total invoiced amount.

methods.name: get_expenses_booked
methods.description: Calculate total expenses booked for the period.

methods.name: get_period_amounts
methods.description: Calculate total amounts and counts for accounts over current and past periods.

methods.name: get_sales_orders_to_bill
methods.description: Calculate total sales order value not yet billed.

methods.name: get_sales_orders_to_deliver
methods.description: Calculate total sales order value not yet delivered.

methods.name: get_purchase_orders_to_receive
methods.description: Calculate total purchase order value not yet received.

methods.name: get_purchase_orders_to_bill
methods.description: Calculate total purchase order value not yet billed.

methods.name: get_type_balance
methods.description: Retrieve balance and count for specific account types and root types.

methods.name: get_roots
methods.description: Get list of root accounts for a given root type.

methods.name: get_root_type_accounts
methods.description: Get list of non-group accounts under a root type, with caching.

methods.name: get_purchase_order
methods.description: Get summary of purchase orders.

methods.name: get_sales_order
methods.description: Get summary of sales orders.

methods.name: get_pending_purchase_orders
methods.description: Get summary of pending purchase orders.

methods.name: get_pending_sales_orders
methods.description: Get summary of pending sales orders.

methods.name: get_sales_invoice
methods.description: Get summary of sales invoices.

methods.name: get_purchase_invoice
methods.description: Get summary of purchase invoices.

methods.name: get_new_quotations
methods.description: Get summary of new quotations.

methods.name: get_pending_quotations
methods.description: Get summary of pending quotations.

methods.name: get_summary_of_pending
methods.description: Get summary data for pending documents.

methods.name: get_summary_of_pending_quotations
methods.description: Get summary data for pending quotations.

methods.name: get_summary_of_doc
methods.description: Get summary data for a specific document type.

methods.name: get_total_on
methods.description: Retrieve total count and sum of grand_total for a document type over a date range.

methods.name: get_from_to_date
methods.description: Calculate date range based on digest frequency.

methods.name: set_dates
methods.description: Set future and past date ranges for the digest.

methods.name: get_next_sending
methods.description: Calculate next scheduled send date.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Initialize next send date when loading the digest.

methods.name: fmt_money
methods.description: Format monetary values with currency.

methods.name: get_purchase_orders_items_overdue_list
methods.description: Retrieve overdue purchase order items and related purchase orders.
